summary:
## New Features

* Introduce CameraFrameEffect and convert the vignette and grading effects by @mvaligursky in #9666
* Add SMAA anti-aliasing as an opt-in CameraFrame effect by @mvaligursky in #9747
* Add auto exposure as an opt-in CameraFrame effect by @mvaligursky in #9757
* Add a lens flare effect to CameraFrame by @mvaligursky in #9734
* Add temporal upscaling to the TAA of CameraFrame by @mvaligursky in #9739
* Add a channel mixer to the CameraFrame color grading by @mvaligursky in #9939
* Add DynamicSkyEffect, a camera frame effect rendering a dynamic sky by @mvaligursky in #9765
* Add haze to DynamicSkyEffect by @mvaligursky in #9897
* Add an Editor script for the DynamicSkyEffect by @mvaligursky in #9859
* Add Sky#enabled and let the sky be hidden per camera by @mvaligursky in #9760
* Make the CameraFrameEffect pass hooks public by @mvaligursky in #9841
* Add frame passes which execute after a camera renders by @mvaligursky in #9707
* Add onBefore and onAfter callbacks to all frame passes by @mvaligursky in #9788
* Make the frame pass classes public by @mvaligursky in #9822
* Make RenderPassForward and CameraComponent#framePasses public by @mvaligursky in #9839
* Add ComputePass, which dispatches computes at a position in the frame by @mvaligursky in #9710
* Add XR view selection and before/after callbacks to ComputePass by @mvaligursky in #9722
* Add Compute#setupDispatchThreads to dispatch for a number of threads by @mvaligursky in #9733
* Add scene depth and color map access to compute shaders by @mvaligursky in #9680
* Add per-camera scene depth and color map handles by @mvaligursky in #9667
* Add the size of the scene map to its handle by @mvaligursky in #9844
* Add planar reflections to StandardMaterial by @mvaligursky in #9902
* Add a Gaussian mipmap filter, and smoother planar reflections by @mvaligursky in #9932
* Add AgX and AgX Punchy tonemapping by @mvaligursky in #9874
* Support the KHR_materials_diffuse_transmission glTF extension by @willeastcott in #9558
* Decode EXT_meshopt_compression and KHR_meshopt_compression glTF buffer views by @willeastcott in #9738
* Add clipping planes to cameras, mesh instances and render components by @willeastcott in #9755
* Add shadowBounds to fit the shadow of a directional light to a box by @mvaligursky in #9791
* Add RoundedBoxGeometry by @mvaligursky in #9849
* Render to a layer of a 2D texture array by @mvaligursky in #9689
* Create and upload volume textures on WebGPU by @mvaligursky in #9695
* Read and copy the depth slices of volume textures by @mvaligursky in #9696
* Render to the depth slices of volume textures by @mvaligursky in #9697
* Add SOG v3 loading and over-unity opacity rendering by @slimbuck in #9873
* Load SPZ version 3 files, enabling SPZ based LCC2 scenes by @mvaligursky in #9980
* Load XGRIDS LCC2 gsplat scenes by @mvaligursky in #9885
* Add SH band 4 support for PLY gaussian splats by @mvaligursky in #9796
* Add VoxelOccupancy and a gaussian splat particle blast example by @mvaligursky in #9907
* Add camera, light, shape and icon gizmos with snapping handles by @kpal81xd in #9809
* Add BoundingBoxGizmo to outline a selection's bounds with corner brackets by @kpal81xd in #9804
* Add gizmo transform readout and Blender-style rotate angle sector by @kpal81xd in #9801
* Add Grid extra and rebuild the Grid script on it by @kpal81xd in #9808
* Add letterSpacing to text elements by @mvaligursky in #9728
* Load TexturePacker and Aseprite sprite sheets as texture atlases by @willeastcott in #9923
* Add per-button mouse mapping and ground pan to CameraControls by @mvaligursky in #9944
* Add an optional screen size to CameraComponent worldToScreen and screenToWorld by @mvaligursky in #9911

## Changes

* Hold the light mask and all uv sets as shader define flags by @mvaligursky in #9659
* Remove the legacy LIT_OLD_AMBIENT combine and LIT_DIFFUSE_MAP by @mvaligursky in #9681
* Deprecate the legacy post effects by @mvaligursky in #9905
* Rename inconsistent public API names behind deprecated aliases by @willeastcott in #9937
* Let a Script base class declare a null scriptName to stay unregistered by @mvaligursky in #9860
* Use setupDispatchThreads in the gsplat compute passes and the compute examples by @mvaligursky in #9735
* Filter distant waves in the water script by @mvaligursky in #9762
* Publish the debug bundles without inline sourcemaps by @willeastcott in #9882

## CameraFrame Effects

* Convert sharpening, fringing, color enhance and color LUT to effects by @mvaligursky in #9679
* Convert bloom to an effect owning its passes and add high quality bloom by @mvaligursky in #9700
* Convert SSAO to an effect and provide the scene depth to effects by @mvaligursky in #9702
* Convert depth of field to a CameraFrame effect by @mvaligursky in #9718
* Convert volumetric fog to a CameraFrame effect by @mvaligursky in #9720
* Convert TAA to a CameraFrame effect at a new resolve stage by @mvaligursky in #9741
* Configure CameraFrame effects when the camera frame is updated by @mvaligursky in #9686
* Add the postOpaque stage and scene color grab to CameraFrame effects by @mvaligursky in #9731
* Provide the scene depth to effects running after the opaque geometry by @mvaligursky in #9732
* Hand CameraFrame effects the time of the frame by @mvaligursky in #9761
* Let CameraFrame effect scripts select their debug views by @mvaligursky in #9742
* Move each CameraFrame effect into its own folder under src/extras/effects by @mvaligursky in #9736
* Move the SMAA and volumetric fog render passes to their own files by @mvaligursky in #9828
* Improve TAA blending on bright edges and under camera motion by @mvaligursky in #9744
* Fix the TAA history drifting with the jitter and losing precision by @mvaligursky in #9737
* Default the auto exposure metering to the 10-90% band by @mvaligursky in #9764
* Replace DynamicSkyEffect clouds and cloudTechnique with cloudType by @mvaligursky in #9772
* Let other materials and the CPU evaluate the DynamicSkyEffect sky by @mvaligursky in #9889
* Scale a LensFlare by the intensity of its light by @mvaligursky in #9773
* Fade the lens flare occlusion with the application time by @mvaligursky in #9858
* Apply the CameraFrame fringing before the sharpening by @mvaligursky in #9855
* Destroy the bloom render target when FramePassBloom is destroyed while disabled by @mvaligursky in #9774

## Gaussian Splatting

* Stream gsplat LOD levels coarsest first across the whole view by @mvaligursky in #9694
* Choose streamed gsplat LOD by walking a node hierarchy by @mvaligursky in #9883
* Fall back to CPU sorting when gsplats exceed GPU storage limits by @mvaligursky in #9854
* Stop allocating the gsplat order buffer when sorting on the GPU by @slimbuck in #9763
* Space gsplat sort keys by log distance so stray far splats keep near precision by @slimbuck in #9899
* Cull splats faded out by modifySplatColor before the GPU sort by @mvaligursky in #9962
* Apply gsplat anti-aliasing per splat, detected from the file by @mvaligursky in #9921
* Add GSplatParams#antiAliasFilterSize by @mvaligursky in #9928
* Default GSplatParams.antiAliasFilterSize to 0.1 by @mvaligursky in #9964
* Use the 3DGS 0.3 px² low-pass filter for gaussian splats by @mvaligursky in #9916
* Lower the default gsplat minContribution from 3 to 2 by @mvaligursky in #9927
* Support any number of typed blind fields in SOG v3 by @mvaligursky in #9960
* Read true gaussian splat opacity from the PLY opacity_linear property by @slimbuck in #9972
* Read Postshot's real anti-aliasing PLY comment by @slimbuck in #9971
* Document the gsplat resource classes and make their aabb read-only by @mvaligursky in #9917
* Distinct gsplat LOD debug colors and billions LOD falloff by @mvaligursky in #9673
* Rebuild gsplat work buffer render targets for runtime-added streams by @mvaligursky in #9876
* Fix GSplatBoxShaderEffect edge tint left behind after the sweep by @mvaligursky in #9758

## Frame Graph & Render Passes

* Skip a disabled frame pass together with its before and after passes by @mvaligursky in #9776
* Do not merge a frame pass which does not execute with its neighbour by @mvaligursky in #9784
* Run camera before-passes and render events for hand-built passes by @mvaligursky in #9780
* Keep the before-passes added to a RenderPassForward by @mvaligursky in #9781
* Render a RenderPassForward with a single camera by @mvaligursky in #9783
* CameraFrame and clustered lighting manage only their own passes by @mvaligursky in #9786
* Document frame pass ownership and flag destroyed pass reuse by @mvaligursky in #9787
* Remove the dead cubemap mipmap skip from the frame graph by @mvaligursky in #9777
* Rename FrameGraph addRenderPass and renderPasses to addPass and passes by @mvaligursky in #9835
* Add RenderPass#resizeSource and copy the resize options of init by @mvaligursky in #9830
* Add RenderPassShaderQuad#numInstances by @mvaligursky in #9832
* Set render pass clears and stores through the setters by @mvaligursky in #9829
* Resolve render pass uniforms once instead of every frame by @mvaligursky in #9833
* Reuse quad render passes in per-frame engine rendering by @mvaligursky in #9827
* Draw drawQuadWithShader with a RenderPassShaderQuad by @mvaligursky in #9825

## Lighting & Shadows

* Use each camera's own cascade split distances for directional shadows by @mvaligursky in #9831
* Share the VSM depth warp exponents between the shadow chunks by @mvaligursky in #9866
* Shadow the volumetric fog correctly with VSM shadow maps by @mvaligursky in #9865
* Fix area light clear coat specular using the base layer's LTC matrix by @mvaligursky in #9973
* Fix clear coat strength being ignored with area lights by @mvaligursky in #9975

## Materials

* Do not tone map the minimal passes of the standard material by @mvaligursky in #9645
* Let the front end of a LitMaterial provide the dispersion by @mvaligursky in #9682
* Declare the dynamic refraction resources in the lit shader by @mvaligursky in #9691
* Give material copies the textures that load after they are copied by @mvaligursky in #9717
* Fix duplicate standard material shader in depth and shadow passes by @mvaligursky in #9778
* Compile iridescence thickness maps on WebGL2, and fix WebGPU iridescence colors by @willeastcott in #9752
* Correct the inverted sheen roughness by @willeastcott in #9836
* Default a missing glTF sheen color factor to black by @willeastcott in #9852
* Honour the clearcoat and sheen gloss invert flags in the glTF exporter by @willeastcott in #9837

## Textures & Render Targets

* Support compressed textures not aligned to the block size on WebGPU by @mvaligursky in #9708
* Fix WebGPU upload of compressed mip levels that are not a multiple of the block size by @mvaligursky in #9701
* Fix the size of compressed volume textures by @mvaligursky in #9706
* Sample only the base level for non-mipmap texture filters on WebGPU by @mvaligursky in #9709
* Update the mip count when Texture.setSource changes the size by @mvaligursky in #9821
* Render to a single face of a cubemap depth buffer on WebGPU by @mvaligursky in #9665

## Gizmos

* Fix gizmo picking, stuck drags, scale snapping, parentless local translate and ViewCube colorNeg by @kpal81xd in #9799
* Harden gizmos: shared layers, layer setter, enabled state, theme hover, multi-touch, arc mesh leak, uniform plane scaling and picking order by @kpal81xd in #9800
* Keep the gizmo readout generic and let each gizmo place it by @kpal81xd in #9803
* Gizmo fixes for editor integration: disabled components, centered icons and flat boxes by @kpal81xd in #9817
* Gizmo fixes for far icons, picking, frustum fill, flat box corners, lines and handle redraws by @kpal81xd in #9818

## XR

* Render directional shadows once for all views in WebGPU XR by @mvaligursky in #9698
* Clear the WebGPU XR projection layer's depth to the far plane by @slimbuck in #9748
* XrNavigation and XrControllers fixes found on Apple Vision Pro by @slimbuck in #9750
* Recover the WebGPU XR projection layer when its texture can no longer be acquired by @slimbuck in #9878
* Skip a screen's touch in XrControllers, which has no model to draw by @slimbuck in #9881

## Performance

* Resolve the picker's meshInstanceId scope id once, not per draw by @mvaligursky in #9657
* Sort opaque draw calls and shadow casters with a radix sort by @mvaligursky in #9662
* Remove per-draw WebGPU error scopes in debug builds by @mvaligursky in #9725
* Always apply the metalness constant, so metalness never selects a shader by @mvaligursky in #9945
* Apply occludeDirect with a uniform, so it never selects a shader by @mvaligursky in #9946
* Apply twoSidedLighting with a uniform, so it never selects a shader by @mvaligursky in #9947
* Stop compiling StandardMaterial shader variants for neutral values by @mvaligursky in #9977
* Invalidate StandardMaterial shaders only when a value changes the shader by @mvaligursky in #9978
* Speed up compilation of clustered area light shaders by @mvaligursky in #9974

## Profiling & Debugging

* Display cubemaps in TextureRenderer as a cross of their faces by @mvaligursky in #9664
* Add compute dispatch and compute pass counters to the stats and MiniStats by @mvaligursky in #9740
* Report buffer operations needing a usage the buffer was not created with by @mvaligursky in #9746
* Report which frame the GPU profiler timings belong to by @mvaligursky in #9838
* Keep GPU pass timings apart, and add scripts for profiling to the inspector example by @mvaligursky in #9842

## Fixes

* Keep MiniStats sized to the canvas when it resizes without a resizecanvas event by @slimbuck in #9661
* Skip the MiniStats draw when it has nothing to render by @mvaligursky in #9672

* Fire devicerestorefailed when WebGPU device recovery fails by @mvaligursky in #9678
* Announce apps to the devtools hook from every build by @mvaligursky in #9646

* Do not fire tween events that have no name by @mvaligursky in #9650
* Accept the alignment array and cookie asset options in Entity#addComponent by @mvaligursky in #9683
* Grab the scene color on the null device without WebGL calls by @mvaligursky in #9684
* Dispatch each Compute instance at most once per frame by @mvaligursky in #9690
* Issue radix sort workgroup atomics from every invocation by @MotivaCG in #9756
* Correct ComputeRadixSort scan growth and destructiveKeys switching by @mvaligursky in #9759
* Delete WebGL vertex array objects with their vertex buffers by @mvaligursky in #9726
* Delete cached WebGL vertex array objects with their vertex buffers by @mvaligursky in #9727
* Destroy old batches when BatchManager.generate() is given no ids by @mvaligursky in #9730
* Preserve event listeners during nested dispatch by @MokiMeow in #9723
* Report a failed loadFromUrl again when its URL is requested again by @slimbuck in #9751
* End a MultiTouchSource touch that leaves without an up or a cancel by @slimbuck in #9749
* Warn about unregistered render containers only when preload starts by @mvaligursky in #9771
* Keep a disabled render or model component out of its batch group by @willeastcott in #9779
* Release held keys when the window loses focus by @kpal81xd in #9811
* Fix WebGPU creation for cross-document canvases by @GibsDev in #9814
* Destroy the WebGPU indirect buffers when the device is destroyed by @mvaligursky in #9823
* Fix math.smoothstep and smootherstep when min is greater than max by @zzoraemon043 in #9798
* Support the HTML-in-Canvas API names shipping in Chrome 157 by @mvaligursky in #9824

* Stop passing the graphics device as BoxGeometry options for the infinite sky by @mvaligursky in #9846
* Destroy the application at once while the graphics context is lost by @mvaligursky in #9862
* Skip parsing a GLB or PLY that finishes downloading after the application is destroyed by @mvaligursky in #9864

* Return the exit point for rays starting inside a BoundingSphere by @mvaligursky in #9930
* Stop applying the anim state speed twice to exit time and progress by @mvaligursky in #9931

## Examples

* Add an integrations category to the examples, with a Spine physics example by @mvaligursky in #9721
